summary: Backend-only testing for FozPay rebrand. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_fozpay.py covering all 14 requested items: registration-disabled (403 with Ukrainian message), admin login/role, admin user CRUD (list/create/duplicate-400/change-password/delete/cannot-delete-self), non-admin 403 on /api/admin/*, hot wallet GET (evm+tron addresses, balances[], total_usd), hot-wallet withdraw insufficient (400 'Недостатньо коштів у гарячому гаманці'), non-EVM chain rejected (400), deposit-address EVM (0x, 42 chars) & TRON (T...), swap+withdraw insufficient (400) on zero-balance user, live prices (USDT≈1, BTC>0), merchant public/private endpoints. 19/19 tests pass against the deployed backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: core.get_current_user prefers cookie over Authorization header — a shared requests.Session that logged in as user A will send A's cookie regardless of Bearer header. Not a bug per se, but easy to trip on. Consider preferring Authorization Bearer when explicitly present, or documenting behavior.
server.py is 1466 lines — recommend splitting admin/user, hot-wallet, wallet, merchant, invoice routers into separate modules for maintainability (>700-line threshold).

admin_users_create returns the full user dict including internal fields (auth_provider, created_at, picture) — consider a response schema. Response uses 'user_id' key, not 'id', which frontends should align on.
test_credentials: admin@fozpay.io / FozPay#Admin2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Merchant X-Auth-Token/Secret used from same file.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral users prefixed test_/hw_/swap_ and delete them; no leftover data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_fozpay.py is the canonical FozPay regression file — run with 'python -m pytest backend/tests/test_fozpay.py -v -o addopts=""'. Notes: (1) backend prefers cookie auth over Bearer, so if using a shared requests.Session, clear cookies between logins under different roles (fixture _clear_cookies does this). (2) POST /api/auth/register is 403 with Ukrainian body — response contains detail 'Публічна реєстрація вимкнена'. (3) Admin user objects use user_id field, not id. (4) Real on-chain sends untested per instructions.
